name: Cinematic Stickman (series)
description: Thick-outline white-headed cartoon characters (hoodies, caps, glasses, bulb-halo host) in dark lit vector sets: spotlight cones, crowds, phone and TV screens, glow, extreme close-ups, a stakes HUD that persists across parts, bold one-to-three word captions with one yellow keyword, and a Part-N end card. Dialogue-driven survival and mystery shorts.
rules: Characters: pure white round head, thick black outline, big expressive brows and eyes, teeth on strong emotion, sweat or tears on fear; clothes are flat shapes (hoodie, cap, tee).
Every shot is lit: a spotlight cone, a red or blue wash, a screen glow; dark vignette; never a flat bright room.
Close-ups carry the emotion (head fills 70 percent of the frame); wide two-shots set the room.
HUD top-left across the whole series (label, big number, caption); the number changes on the story beat.
Captions: bold white one to three words with one yellow keyword; end card: title, PART N, FOLLOW FOR PART N+1.
native_moves: a punch-in on the face for the punchline, then a wide reaction shot
a speech bubble popping on the key word
a prop gag (an empty wallet, a phone) held up to the lens

structures: setup, escalation, deadpan reveal, one-line payoff
two-person argument that flips who is right at the end
a lie that grows each shot until the set gives it away
openings: cold open on the funniest face
a bold claim said straight to the other character
a prop dropped onto the table
endings: wide shot, silence, then the reaction face
the twist line over a tight close-up
a loop back to the first line with the roles swapped

camera_language: Wide two-shot to establish, then tight punch-ins on the speaker's face; shot and reverse shot on dialogue, cut on the line; slow 3 percent per second push inside every hold; no whip pans.
typography: stroke-word captions at 70 px, two lines at most; yellow title bar in heavy italic for the square comic variant.
audio_direction: Light playful bed at -22 dB under the voice; a pop or thud on each expression swap; one beat of silence before the payoff.
pitfalls: Do not wobble or boil the line: this style is clean.
Do not leave both characters with the same face for more than a second.
Keep clothes colours distinct from the set key colour.
